_note: Choices for the confinement quote comparer. 'typical' = package types with typical 2026 prices (malaysia4u.com/confinement-guide). 'centres' = real centres with their own published prices; re-check every few months. Centres: only those publishing a price on their own site (10 of ~60 checked on 25 Nov 2026); every price re-confirmed on the centre's page that day.

typical.note_en: Typical outside central KL (e.g. Johor): about RM9,000-12,000.
typical.note_ms: Biasa di luar pusat KL (cth. Johor): lebih kurang RM9,000-12,000.

typical.note_en: Typical 2026 range RM12,000-18,000; the standard tier is often 1 nurse to 4 babies.
typical.note_ms: Julat biasa 2026: RM12,000-18,000; peringkat standard selalunya 1 jururawat untuk 4 bayi.

typical.note_en: Luxury suites are about RM20,000 to RM40,000 or more.
typical.note_ms: Suite mewah lebih kurang RM20,000 hingga RM40,000 atau lebih.

centres.name: Terra Confinement Care
centres.caveat_en: Price depends on room type; postnatal massage is a separate service.
centres.caveat_ms: Harga ikut jenis bilik; urutan selepas bersalin ialah perkhidmatan berasingan.

centres.name: Sunway Sanctuary Postnatal Care
centres.caveat_en: Only the cheapest room's price is published.

centres.name: Roseville Confinement Villa & Spa
centres.caveat_en: Promo price until 31 Dec 2026 (normally from RM24,000). Breastfeeding help and laundry cost extra.
centres.caveat_ms: Harga promosi hingga 31 Dis 2026 (biasanya dari RM24,000). Bantuan penyusuan dan dobi dikenakan caj tambahan.

centres.name: Orchid Villa Confinement Centre
centres.caveat_en: Halal meals, Syariah-compliant. Night care for baby (10pm-7am) costs extra.
centres.caveat_ms: Makanan halal, patuh Syariah. Jagaan bayi waktu malam (10mlm-7pg) dikenakan caj tambahan.

centres.name: De Joy's Confinement
centres.caveat_en: Menu includes pork. Massage and husband-stay details are still 'to be confirmed' on their site.
centres.caveat_ms: Menu termasuk babi. Butiran urutan dan suami tinggal masih 'akan disahkan' di laman mereka.

centres.name: San Lyra Postnatal Rejuvenation Centre
centres.caveat_en: Starting prices - the final price depends on room, length of stay and treatments.
centres.caveat_ms: Harga permulaan - harga akhir bergantung pada bilik, tempoh dan rawatan.

centres.name: Byond28 Confinement Care
centres.caveat_en: The stay length isn't stated next to the price - confirm it's 28 days.
centres.caveat_ms: Tempoh penginapan tidak dinyatakan bersama harga - sahkan sama ada 28 hari.

centres.name: Harvest Confinement Centre (Johor Bahru)
centres.caveat_en: 'From' price - the exact price is confirmed on WhatsApp.
centres.caveat_ms: Harga 'dari' - harga tepat disahkan melalui WhatsApp.

centres.name: Harvest Confinement Centre (Kulai & Senai)
centres.caveat_en: 'From' price - the exact price is confirmed on WhatsApp.
centres.caveat_ms: Harga 'dari' - harga tepat disahkan melalui WhatsApp.

centres.name: Carnation Confinement Home
centres.caveat_en: Stay length isn't stated on the price page - confirm it. Dad can stay overnight in every room except the cheapest.
centres.caveat_ms: Tempoh tidak dinyatakan di halaman harga - sahkan. Bapa boleh bermalam di semua bilik kecuali yang termurah.

home_care.name: Mami Confinement Care
home_care.area_en: Malaysia - ask if they cover your area
home_care.area_ms: Malaysia - tanya sama ada kawasan anda diliputi
home_care.note_en: Live-in pantang carer: herbal baths, pantang cooking, sauna, tungku and binder for mum; baby bath and massage; housework and laundry. A second package is from RM1,900 per 7 days. Transport is extra.
home_care.note_ms: Penjaga pantang tinggal bersama: mandian herba, masakan pantang, sauna, tungku dan bengkung untuk ibu; mandi dan urut bayi; kemas rumah dan cuci pakaian. Pakej kedua dari RM1,900 untuk 7 hari. Caj pengangkutan tidak termasuk.
